description_en: Queries the details of multiple devices under a specified product
description_zh: 查询指定产品下多个设备的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-query-device-detail --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchQueryDeviceDetail

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the devices specified by DeviceName.N belong
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter has a value, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If <props="intl"><ph>the Overview page or </ph></props>this parameter does not have a value, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of device names to query. You can specify up to 100 device names.

The devices to query must belong to the same product
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备名称列表。最多可包含100个设备名称。

查询的设备必须在同一产品下
parameters.name: device_name

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The device details returned if the call was successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回设备的详细信息

FirmwareVersion.description_en: The firmware version of the device

GmtActive.description_en: The activation time of the device in GMT format

GmtCreate.description_en: The creation time of the device in GMT format

IotId.description_en: The ID issued by IoT Platform for the device. This is the unique identifier of the device
IotId.description_zh: 物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符

NodeType.description_en:
The node type. Valid values:
0: Device. A device cannot have sub-devices. It can connect to IoT Platform directly or as a sub-device of a gateway.
1: Gateway. A gateway can have sub-devices. It has a sub-device management module, maintains the topological relationships of sub-devices, and synchronizes the topological relationships to IoT Platform
NodeType.description_zh:
节点类型，取值：
0：设备。设备不能挂载子设备。可以直连物联网平台，也可以作为网关的子设备连接物联网平台。
1：网关。网关可以挂载子设备，具有子设备管理模块，维持子设备的拓扑关系，和将拓扑关系同步到物联网平台

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs

ProductName.description_en: The name of the product to which the device belongs

Region.description_en: The region where the device resides. This value corresponds to the region of the IoT Platform service in the console
Region.description_zh: 设备所在地域（与控制台上物联网平台服务地域对应）

Status.description_en:
The device status. Valid values:
ONLINE: The device is online.
OFFLINE: The device is offline.
UNACTIVE: The device is not activated.
DISABLE: The device is disabled
Status.description_zh:
设备状态。取值：
ONLINE：设备在线。
OFFLINE：设备离线。
UNACTIVE：设备未激活。
DISABLE：设备已禁用

UtcActive.description_en: The activation time of the device in UTC format

UtcCreate.description_en: The creation time of the device in UTC format

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
